title: Drunk Woman Claims Officer Tried To Sexually Assault Her After Being Arrested
description:
#news #police #arrest

On February 8th, 2022. Officers were dispatched to the airport due to reports of an intoxicated woman that was denied boarding on her flight. The gate agents were concerned for her safety due to how unresponsive she was. After officers detained her, she started becoming stubborn even up to the point where she accused an officer of raping her and she started banging on the glass of the squad car. The woman was identified as 45 year old “Julie”.
